title: The Margin
description: A complete blogging platform: sign up, write in Markdown with cover uploads and tags, publish, read and leave notes. Posts, comments, auth and moderation all run on a Supabase Postgres backend.
my_part: Built the whole app, including the database schema, auth, REST API, moderation and UI.

title: Northstar Store
description: A full-stack e-commerce store with product catalog, cart, checkout, JWT accounts and admin order management. Checkout runs in a transaction, re-reading prices and decrementing stock atomically.
my_part: Built the whole app, from the database schema to the storefront and admin screens.

title: Task Management System
description: A Kanban task manager with real-time updates, JWT authentication and optimistic React Query caching over a Socket.io backend.
my_part: Built the whole app, including the real-time board, auth and REST API.

title: Personal Portfolio
description: This site: a full-stack portfolio with a REST API serving projects, skills and certifications from MongoDB Atlas, plus a contact form and a JSON/SQLite fallback for local runs.
my_part: Designed and built the whole site and its deployment.
